FN-75PK2V-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 220
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/26/2023
Senate Bill 220 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of the State Employees'
Health Insurance Plan (SEHIP) and the Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan
(PEEHIP) by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of alternative
medications recommended by a pharmacist when the acquisition cost for the pharmacy or
pharmacist for a specific medication is below or above what the pharmacy benefits manager
reimburses.

decrease the obligations of the State Employees' Health Insurance Plan (SEHIP) and the Public
Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan (PEEHIP) by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the difference in the cost of alternative medications recommended by a pharmacist when
the acquisition cost for the pharmacy or pharmacist for a specific medication is below or above
what the pharmacy benefits manager reimburses.
